# Live multi-homed macOS capture, 2026-09-01, M5 in the cabin.
# Wi-Fi en0 = 192.168.8.134, wired en5 = 192.168.8.234, DEFAULT ROUTE ON en5.
# This is the en0-defect scenario in the flesh: network_info_plus would report
# en0 (.134, Wi-Fi) while the real default route is en5 (.234, wired).
# Captured with the same three commands link_info parses.

=== route -n get default ===
   route to: default
destination: default
       mask: default
    gateway: 192.168.8.1
  interface: en5
      flags: <UP,GATEWAY,DONE,STATIC,PRCLONING,GLOBAL>
 recvpipe  sendpipe  ssthresh  rtt,msec    rttvar  hopcount      mtu     expire
       0         0         0         0         0         0      1500         0
